items.exampleEn: I drink orange juice every morning.
I put some beans in the soup.
items.exampleZh: 我在湯裡放了一些豆子。

items.exampleEn: This salad has tomatoes in it.
I like butter on my bread.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡在麵包上塗奶油。

items.exampleEn: An apple a day is good for you.
items.exampleZh: 一天一顆蘋果，對你有益。

items.exampleEn: I want a green salad, please.

items.audioEn: I am not very hungry. I only want a salad.
items.audioZh: 我不太餓，我只想吃沙拉。

items.sentenceEn: There are beans and tomatoes in the soup.
Can I have some butter, please?

items.stemEn: I am ____. Can we eat now?
items.stemZh: 我餓了，我們現在可以吃飯嗎？

items.stemEn: I drink a glass of apple ____ every day.

items.passageEn: It is twelve, and Tom is hungry. He goes to a small restaurant near his office. He does not want a big meal, so he has a salad and a bowl of tomato soup. He also drinks a glass of apple juice. The soup is hot and good.
items.passageZh: 現在十二點，Tom 肚子餓了。他到辦公室附近的一家小餐廳。他不想吃太多，所以點了一份沙拉和一碗番茄湯。他也喝了一杯蘋果汁。湯熱熱的，很好喝。

referenceEn: I am very hungry. I want some soup.
I'm hungry, and I want to have some soup.
rubricZh: 「很餓」用 be 動詞＋hungry（例如 I am very hungry）
「喝湯」常說 have soup 或 eat soup，寫 drink soup 也可以接受

items.instructionZh: 用 apple 造一個句子，說說你多常吃蘋果或什麼時候吃。
referenceEn: I eat an apple every day.
I often eat apples after dinner.
rubricZh: 一顆蘋果用 an apple（母音開頭用 an）
泛指蘋果時用複數 apples（例如 I like apples）
